stem: A bicycle was originally priced at \(p\) dollars. In March the price was increased by 25%. In April the March price was reduced by \$60. In May the April price was reduced by 20%, giving a price of \$300. What is the value of \(p\)?
solution: March price: \(1.25p\). April price: \(1.25p - 60\). May price: \(0.8(1.25p - 60)\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the result of applying the \$60 reduction after the 20% discount: \(0.8(1.25p) - 60 = 300\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the result of adding \$60 instead of subtracting it: \(0.8(1.25p + 60) = 300\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the April price, \(1.25p - 60\), not the original price.

verify:
p = symbols('p')
s = solve(Eq(Rational(4, 5)*(Rational(5, 4)*p - 60), 300), p)[0]
assert s == 348
assert value(choices[answer]) == s
assert all(value(choices[k]) != s for k in choices if k != answer)
